shots.action: Fading up from black, a long-haired schoolgirl in a red-and-black striped shirt sits motionless in profile between facing mirrors, her reflection repeating in an endless receding row.

A young woman in a striped shirt sits in profile in a mirrored room, her reflection repeating into the distance, while an insert shows a smartphone sealed in a clear evidence bag on the table before a close-up of her lowering her eyes.

Insert of a black portfolio labelled in Thai with a schoolgirl's name, then the bespectacled girl and her father sitting across a desk from a person seen from behind in a wood-panelled office with trophies, and a page in the binder showing a newspaper clipping headlined "The new Crossword Champion".

A woman in a white blouse speaks across a desk, a bespectacled schoolgirl in uniform answers, and a man in shirt and tie talks at a trophy-lined desk as handwritten fee and fare figures appear over the frames.

Extreme close-up of a young woman's face looking into the lens, then two schoolgirls' feet in black Mary Jane shoes on a terrazzo floor, then a bespectacled man with a tripod-mounted camera showing the screen to a smiling schoolgirl in white uniform outside the school building.

Two schoolgirls in white uniforms sit cross-legged on the floor of a library aisle between bookshelves, talking over a pink sheet of paper one of them holds, then lean in close together as they read it.

Two schoolgirls in uniform sit on the floor of a library aisle leaning close over a small book, then a young woman in a striped shirt sits alone at a table in a dark room facing the camera and lowers her eyes.

A young woman sits alone facing the camera at a table in a dark room, then the shot cuts to a bright classroom of uniformed students seated at desks with a teacher at the front, overlaid with a red Thai title card reading "midterm exam".

In a bright classroom full of uniformed students at their desks, a girl bends over her paper with one hand raised beside her head holding her fingers in a fixed position, and another student turns to look back over her shoulder.

In a classroom full of uniformed students taking an exam, a schoolgirl writes at her desk, and inserts show Thai letters pencilled along the side of an eraser held over a multiple-choice answer sheet and digits scribbled on scratch paper.
In a classroom of uniformed students, a schoolgirl bent over her paper lifts her head and looks off to the side past a blurred classmate in the foreground.

Floor-level shot under classroom desks as a student's white-socked foot slides out of a black school shoe and nudges it forward across the tiles, with other seated students' legs and shoes in the background.
In a classroom of uniformed students a schoolgirl at her desk looks down and works her foot out of her black school shoe, and the shoe slides across the tiled floor away from the desk legs.

During a classroom exam a ponytailed schoolgirl sits writing while the girl behind her stares over anxiously, a black school shoe lies slipped off on the tiled floor between the desks, and a man in a grey shirt stands proctoring at the front of the room.
A close-up of a white bathrobe embroidered "Patton Hotel Bangkok" cuts to a figure lunging into a lit hotel pool at night, throwing up a sheet of spray across the water.

In a rooftop pool at night a shirtless young man surfaces and slicks back his wet hair while two young women in swimsuits shield their faces from the splash, and the three then settle at the pool wall talking.

Quick cuts from a night-lit swimming pool where a girl leans on the edge, to an extreme close-up of a pen signing the dotted line of a printed bill marked "Thank you", to a smiling young man in a white school shirt facing camera against a flat red backdrop.

At night by a lit outdoor pool, a shirtless young man sits in the water holding a bottle against an inflatable ring while a young woman in a blue swimsuit and white robe sits at the poolside beside a champagne glass, smiling and then looking down.

In a dim study lit by a desk lamp, a ponytailed girl crouches at a desk sorting through stacked papers and holds up a Thai receipt for a 200,000-baht school entrance fee, then reads it seated, seen through foreground furniture.
Close-up of hands leafing through a stack of official documents in plastic sleeves, pulling out an ornate certificate, past a framed photo of a man cradling a baby on a shelf.
Close-up of a young woman in a warm, dimly lit room holding up a sheet of paper and reading it, tears running down her cheek.
Tight close-ups of a person in a maroon floral T-shirt playing an upright piano in a dim room, moving from their hands on the keys to their shoulder and unseen face in profile.

In a dimly lit apartment a teenage girl in a maroon t-shirt stands with her head lowered while a bespectacled man in a white tank top faces her from across the room, then walks out through the archway past the piano.

A group of young people crowded together on a sofa in a cluttered living room lean forward and stare off-screen with tense, dismayed faces, the young man in the orange-striped shirt at centre hunched over and grimacing.
A young woman in a red T-shirt sings as she plays an upright piano in a sunlit room with barred windows and electric fans, while several people sit watching her from the foreground.
A teenage girl in a red physics-olympiad T-shirt stands beside an upright piano in a sunlit room, speaking toward a small group of students seated with their backs to the camera.

A schoolgirl in a red T-shirt plays an upright piano with her eyes closed by a barred window, then the window cuts to a white classroom wall where a round clock and a small Thai flag are watched over the blurred shoulder of someone in the foreground.

In a classroom of uniformed students, a schoolgirl sits back with a pencil held to her lips and stares off, hands and an eraser move across the edges of adjoining desks, and a second schoolgirl rests her chin on her hand and smiles while writing on a pink pad.
A young woman in stage costume and a blue headscarf bows with a bouquet before a red curtain as silhouetted audience members applaud, then the window cuts to a close-up of a hand playing piano keys.

A black luxury sedan pulls up to the school driveway and a boy in white school uniform steps out beside it, intercut with an extreme close-up of a pencil filling in a bubble on a Thai multiple-choice answer sheet at question 30.

In a bright exam room two male students in white school uniforms twist around in their seats to glance back down the row, then a macro shot shows a pencil filling in a bubble of Thai letters on a multiple-choice answer sheet.

Close-ups of a hand sketching a circular diagram on paper and of a bank passbook's columns of dated deposits and balances, then a young woman seated among bookshelves reading the passbook while a blurred figure stands in the foreground.

A figure in a white shirt works at a photocopier in a dim room by a stairwell, then in a bright school corridor a male student leans in close to speak to a ponytailed schoolgirl while a second girl beside her listens and both girls' faces are held in close-up.

Four students in white school uniforms stand smiling and waving for a photo outside the school, then the camera shows large congratulation banners for the 2557 honour-scholarship students, each printed with a student's portrait, hanging high on the school building's concrete facade.
A young man in a white school shirt stares straight into the camera in a centred portrait framing as the deep red backdrop drains to black-and-white.
A young man in a white school shirt stands with his head bowed in a dim room, holding a school name tag reading "แบงค์" in both hands.
Close-up of a school shirt name tag reading "แบงค์", then a wide of the boy alone in an empty tiled school restroom, hunched over the sink washing at the mirror.

A young man in a blue polo shirt sits alone at a bare table with a glass of water in a dark room, speaking toward the camera, then the window cuts to a backstage view of a bright blue quiz-show set where a suited host stands and two students in uniform watch from behind a lighting rig.

A schoolgirl in a white uniform stands against a warm wood-panelled wall looking off-screen past a blurred head in the foreground, and the window cuts to a boy in the same uniform seen in profile in a dim room with a studio light stand behind him.

On a blue "Teen Genius" TV quiz set, a schoolboy waits in profile beside a studio lamp before he and a schoolgirl in uniform stand at the contestants' podium while a bespectacled host in a grey suit speaks from his desk.

A television in an office plays a 'Teen Genius' quiz show with a grinning host holding a card, then a middle-aged woman in a white blouse perches on the edge of the desk speaking to a uniformed student who stands in the foreground with their back to the camera.
A schoolboy holding a backpack and a schoolgirl in uniform stand side by side in a glass-partitioned school office, listening to someone off-screen while a man works at a desk behind them.

A male student in white school uniform walks past a glass-walled school office holding his backpack, then a middle-aged woman seated behind a desk talks across it to a boy and a ponytailed girl in uniform seen from behind.

A young man in a school shirt with earphones in works at a laundry, his hands scrubbing soapy cloth in a basin while a phone playing a video sits on a Thai mathematics textbook on the bench beside him.

A phone playing a video sits on a Thai maths textbook with earphones on a wooden table, hands scrub foamy laundry, and a student in a white school shirt sits with his back to camera among washing machines in a cramped laundry room.
In a dark room, a young woman in a striped rust-and-navy top sits with her eyes lowered, then lifts her gaze off-camera as the shot pushes into a close-up of her still face.

Two male students in white school uniforms stand face to face in an open school corridor talking in shot/reverse-shot, the bespectacled one speaking while the other, a backpack strap over his shoulder, listens and answers.

Close-up from behind of a schoolboy in a white uniform shirt wearing an earphone, then a high wide view of a vast hall filled with rows of spaced-out desks where a single student sits alone taking an exam.

A male student sits alone at his desk taking a written exam in a vast hall of evenly spaced desks watched over by a proctor, the shot closing to an extreme close-up of his face as he looks down at his paper.
Extreme close-up of a stamped Thai exam answer form being filled in, then a wide view of a large hall where rows of students in white uniforms sit at spaced desks writing their papers.

A dissolve over rows of uniformed students writing at desks in a large exam hall gives way to macro inserts of a pencil filling in a bubble on a numbered answer sheet and of a sharpener packed with shavings held between fingers.

Insert close-ups during an exam: a wall clock reading roughly 9:40, then an unseen student's hand shading bubbles on a multiple-choice answer sheet, ending on Thai question 40 asking which exam set the student received.
In a large exam hall a male student in school uniform fills in an answer sheet with a pen, then leans back with eyes closed and a strained face while his hand moves rapidly in the air beside him.
In a large exam hall a male student in white uniform looks up toward the front, then a middle-aged male invigilator seated at a desk with a green lamp addresses the rows of students.

In a cavernous exam hall lined with bleachers, a schoolgirl in white uniform stands and looks up off-screen while rows of seated students work at single desks, one girl twisting round in her seat with an exam paper in hand and three uniformed boys blurred in the foreground.

A close-up insert of a Thai exam paper header reading "ก. ชุดที่ 1" cuts to a male student seated among rows of uniformed test-takers in a large exam hall, looking down at his paper and then glancing off to his side.

In a dim school exam hall, uniformed students sit writing at widely spaced desks while a boy in glasses twists around in his seat, and the shot closes in on a young man's profile as he stares ahead with his lips parted.

A hand carries exam papers and a pencil past rows of desks in a test hall, a schoolgirl in white uniform glances back over her shoulder, and hands flatten a sheet bearing a large underlined pencil message in Thai.
A schoolgirl in white uniform glances back over her shoulder in an exam room, then students rise and crowd the invigilator's desk to hand in their papers.

In a large exam hall a schoolgirl in a white uniform shirt handles answer sheets while students file past desks, a wall clock reads about 10:10, and a bespectacled boy grimaces over his paper in a classroom.

Close shots of a hand writing dense equations on an exam paper and fingers sliding over a multiple-choice bubble sheet, then a tight close-up of a schoolgirl's face bent over her desk, brow furrowed in concentration.
A schoolgirl in white uniform hunches over her exam desk working at a small eraser with her fingers in close-up, with a cutaway to a shoe on the wooden floor beneath the desks.

Extreme close-up of a pencil filling in a bubble on a multiple-choice answer sheet, then a schoolgirl in uniform at her exam desk stretching with both arms behind her head and eyes closed, and her fingers resting and tapping on the desk edge beside the paper.

A sweating schoolgirl in uniform stares off-screen in a dim exam hall, intercut with a low-angle night shot of a grey-haired man in a light shirt raising his fist outside a building and a close-up of a hand pressed flat on a wooden desk beside an exam paper.

A hand presses flat on a wooden desk, then an invigilator's hand lays exam papers and an answer sheet in front of a seated student writing with a pen, while a wide view shows the uniformed proctor leaning over a desk in a sparse exam hall of spaced-out students.
A grey-haired man in a white shirt and tie looks down at someone off-screen in a large hall, then a ponytailed schoolgirl in white uniform glances up and lowers her eyes at her desk.
In a gymnasium, a bespectacled schoolboy in a white uniform shirt is struck and recoils, his head snapping back as a gold-braceleted arm swings at him.

In a school exam hall a uniformed schoolgirl clasps her hands and pleads up at an invigilator standing over her desk before slumping face-down on her papers, while a male student at a nearby desk looks up and speaks to the same invigilator.

A phone screen shows a Thai group chat read by 26 people thanking "P'Lin", then three students in white school uniforms sit on outdoor steps, one boy scrolling his phone, one girl resting her chin on her hand, and a second girl standing behind her arranging her hair.

Three students in white school uniforms sit on marble steps outside a building, one girl standing behind fixing the seated girl's hair while the boy beside her holds a phone, and the two seated ones turn to look off-screen as someone passes in the foreground.

A grey-haired man in a shirt and tie stands at a house doorway looking down at a brown envelope in his hands, then three students in white school uniforms sit on a low ledge outside a building while the girl on the right talks and gestures and the other two lean over a phone.

A tall schoolgirl in uniform stands motionless on an outdoor school walkway while a second schoolgirl crouches low beside her looking up with a tense expression, then the shot cuts to a tight close-up of a closed wooden door and its metal knob.

A schoolgirl in white uniform walks through a school room, then in an office a short-haired woman seated behind a desk talks with uniformed students standing around the table while one of them hands her a sheet of paper.
A middle-aged woman in a navy blouse sits at a wooden desk in a wood-panelled office, leafing through a stack of printed answer sheets with both hands.

Lynn and Bank stand at attention in white school uniforms in front of a desk in a school office while a short-haired woman seated in a leather chair talks across the table and another man works at a computer in the background.

Seen first through a glass partition in a blinded office where a woman and a man sit on either side of her, a schoolgirl in a white uniform stands between them and the camera pushes in to her downturned profile as she listens.

In a wood-panelled office, a schoolboy in a white uniform shirt stands open-mouthed in shock and then settles into a blank stare, intercut with a bespectacled older man in a checked shirt seated by a television and a model sailing ship, looking off toward him as he speaks.

In an office lined with trophies and plaques, a middle-aged woman looks off-screen with a strained, tearful expression, then a thin bespectacled man in a checked shirt sits facing the same direction, listening with a troubled look.

An older bespectacled man in a checked shirt sits with his head bowed in a sunlit living room and then stands leaning in a school doorway, while a woman in a dark blouse sits behind an office desk with her hands clasped, speaking toward someone off-screen.

A uniformed schoolgirl stands beside a grey-haired man in glasses in a school office with another student waiting at the right, then the shot cuts to a close-up of the girl's face in an open corridor as she looks off-camera and speaks.

A bespectacled older man in a checked shirt stoops past a metal-framed interior, then a schoolgirl and a schoolboy in white uniforms stand close together in a wood-panelled office, both looking down at something off-frame and speaking quietly.
Hands hold up a bank passbook filled with large deposit entries, then an older man in glasses leans on a dining table facing Lynn, still in her school uniform, across from him.
Tight close-up of a young woman with shoulder-length dark hair in a cream patterned blouse, eyes wet and downcast in a dim room, who lifts her gaze off-camera and parts her lips to speak.

Extreme close-up of a hand pulling the tab on a chilled blue soda can until foam wells up over the lid, then a young woman with long dark hair in a striped shirt raises the can to her lips and closes her eyes with a satisfied smile.
A young woman in a yellow t-shirt sits at a table in a dark wood-panelled room, facing and speaking to an out-of-focus person in the right foreground.

At a candlelit restaurant table a middle-aged woman talks and gestures animatedly beside a middle-aged man, both smiling across the table at a young woman with long dark hair who listens and smiles back over the wine glasses.

A close insert of a Boston University College of Communication brochure lying on a bed cuts to a smiling schoolgirl in a blue-striped uniform shirt talking animatedly across a table to a person seen from behind in a wood-panelled room.
Hands slide an orange STIC prep book across a yellow tablecloth, then a girl in a yellow t-shirt sits at the table talking to a person seen from behind in the foreground.

In a dim wood-panelled dining room, a smiling woman in a striped shirt talks across the table to Lynn, who sits in a yellow T-shirt clutching a paper bag and listens without smiling in the reverse angle.
In a warmly lit hotel lobby a Western man in a brown jacket holds up his phone to show a photo of a little girl in a blue dress to a young woman in a yellow t-shirt, who smiles as she looks at it.
Tight close-up of a ponytailed young woman in a yellow top looking up and off-screen, a chandelier glowing out of focus behind her.
A wall of world clocks labelled New York, Dubai and Bangkok showing different times, intercut with a young woman in a yellow top gazing up at them under a chandelier.

A ponytailed young woman in a yellow shirt stands at a hotel front desk beneath a row of world clocks labelled Bangkok, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney, her face tilted upward in close-up under the warm lobby lights.

A wall clock over a brass plate reading SYDNEY, then a high angle on a young woman in a yellow "Making It Happen" T-shirt gazing up before she stands at the stone counter beneath the row of world clocks.
Extreme close-up of a world map on a desk as an unseen person's hand plants a small red flag pin into Australia.

A standing figure plants a red pin on Australia on a world map spread across a workshop table while a young woman in pink and a young man in denim watch from the far side, first slumped on their hands and then sitting up wide-eyed and grinning.

In a cluttered workshop, a young man and a woman in pink sit at a table spread with a world map and talk up at a tall girl in a red t-shirt standing over them, the man gesturing with his hands as he explains.
At night a young man in a white shirt and helmet rides a motorbike down a wet city street with a taxi close behind him, and the taxi then drives on alone.
At night outside a teal iron gate, a young man in a white school shirt and dark shorts wrestles a washing-machine drum lashed with cord onto the back of a parked motorbike.
At night a young man in a white school uniform shirt hauls a large teal laundry cart along the pavement past a green gated shopfront and a parked motorbike.

Grainy timestamped black-and-white CCTV footage of a night street outside a metal gate, where several people scuffle beside a parked motorbike and a pickup truck until one of them is knocked to the ground.

Extreme close-up of a battered young man's face with a swollen bloodied eye and cuts, widening out to show him lying on his back in a heap of garbage in a stained white school shirt, raising a mud-caked hand toward his injured eye as he opens his eyes.
A young man in a torn, bloodstained white school shirt pushes himself up from lying on a vast open landfill and sits among the trash and old tyres, his face cut and bleeding.
A bloodied schoolboy in a torn, mud-stained white uniform screams and then collapses sobbing into the mud of a vast garbage dump.

Two schoolgirls in white uniforms crouch together on a sunlit rooftop talking and looking off-screen, then the shot cuts to students in uniform filing up a brass-railed staircase past a red signboard reading "โครงการสัมมนา เพื่อความเป็นหนึ่งด้านการศึกษา 2B COME WON".
A young man in a black turtleneck speaks into a handheld microphone on a spotlit stage before a seated audience, pacing in front of a large projected STIC logo.
In a darkened hall, rows of students in school uniforms sit slumped in chairs facing a projector lamp mounted on a tripod, as the camera drifts across the seated group.
Extreme close-ups of a hand turning a sharpened pencil in the dark, a barcode printed on a white sheet, and the pencil held upright against that barcode.
In a darkened auditorium a lone student in school uniform stands in a spotlight on stage beside a large projected slide showing a barcode and a test paper, facing rows of seated students.

In a darkened auditorium a lone figure stands beside a lectern presenting to rows of seated students, then the projected slide fills the frame showing a row of pale vertical bars with two dark bars labelled A and B in red.

A young man in a black turtleneck paces and talks in front of a large projection of barcoded 2B pencils, ending on a close graphic of one pencil with its barcode segment boxed and labelled in Thai as the GRID-IN answer.

A young woman in a red raglan tee speaks and then turns away inside a machinery-filled workshop, and in a later frame a smiling girl and a boy in a navy bomber jacket lean over a table pressing coloured pins into a board beside a STIC prep box.

A schoolgirl in uniform, seen from behind, stands among racks of hanging clothes in a laundry shop and talks across the counter to a young man handling folded laundry, with a woman visible in the doorway behind him.
In a laundry shop lined with shelves of wrapped clothes, a schoolgirl stands holding a bundle and speaks with a young man standing by an ironing board and calendar on the far wall.

In a laundry shop lined with shelves of plastic-wrapped folded linen, a long-haired young woman in a white ringer tee stands with her arms crossed and talks toward a young man in a navy polo who looks up from the ironing station across the room.

A figure walks in silhouette through a doorway into a fluorescent-lit printing workshop marked "SAFETY FIRST", where a long-haired young woman in a rust shirt stands in close-up looking off-screen while three other people wait among the presses behind her.

Inside a printing workshop a young woman stands tensely beside an offset press while two young men face each other and talk among the machines, and the window cuts to a close-up of a long-haired young woman in a brown shirt standing in front of a large press.

In a printing plant beside Heidelberg presses, a young woman in a rust sweater and a young man in a blue polo sit apart on the machines' step platforms with MacBook laptops on their laps, and she turns her head toward him.

Grace and Pat sit side by side at a classroom table with papers as Pat turns to speak to her, then Lynn stands watching her father read a sheet in a dim room, and a MacBook screen shows a 'Teen Genius' graphic open in Photoshop.
Inside a printing shop beside a Heidelberg offset press, Lynn speaks in profile while Pat sits with his arm around Grace and a bruised-faced Bank listens from a chair nearby.
Fading up from black, a top-down overhead view of a school stairwell shows three students in uniform walking down the terrazzo steps past the handrail, seen only from above so no faces are visible.
A young man in a floral shirt sits alone at a wooden table in a dark room, face crumpling as he weeps and then covers his eyes with his hands.
A young man in a dark floral shirt sits alone at a bare wooden table in a dim room, wiping his eyes and speaking toward someone off-screen as he breaks down in tears.
In a dim room, a young man in a dark floral shirt leans over a table talking and gesturing toward two people seated with their backs to the camera in the foreground.

Across a table in a dim office a young man in a floral shirt leans in talking and points a finger at a girl in a striped top seen from behind, while another angle shows her filling in a form at a desk with a woman in a pale dress and a young man in a blue sweater standing behind her.
In a dim room, a young man in a floral shirt leans over a table talking and gesturing animatedly at two people seated opposite him, seen from behind.

In a dim room with window blinds, a young man in a floral shirt sits across a table gesturing with his hands as he talks to a girl in a striped shirt who sits with a notebook and pen, while a woman in a pale dress and a young man in a blue sweatshirt stand behind her.

A young man in a floral shirt sits across a table from a long-haired girl in a dark room and speaks to her, then the window cuts to a close profile of a young man in a blue top staring off past the camera in a dim locker corridor with a blurred girl seated behind him.

In a dim shop back room hung with clothes on racks, a young woman in a striped shirt stands behind a counter shouting at a person whose back is to the camera, while a young man in a blue shirt hunches forward in close-up with a hand pressed to his head.

In a dim wood-panelled room, a long-haired young woman in a striped tank top crouches and shields her head with one arm as a young man in a navy shirt lurches past the camera in a blur of violent movement.

In a dim wood-panelled room beneath a JESUS wall plaque, a young man in a dark floral shirt grabs the face and then the neck of a sweating young man in a blue polo shirt as the two shout at each other at arm's length.

In a dim teal-walled room, a young woman in a navy-and-orange striped top cries with a bloodied nose while a second woman in a cream polka-dot blouse stands close behind her, both lowering their heads as the shot holds.

A young man stands alone in a dark station corridor beside a lit Thai laundry-detergent billboard, then a woman in a patterned blouse talks to another woman in a dim green-lit space, smiling before dropping her eyes.
Two schoolgirls stand facing each other in a dim corridor behind an open folding gate, talking in close alternating profiles before the camera pulls back to a wide two-shot.

At night under a lit pedestrian overpass marked with a green arrow and red X lane signal, a young woman in a striped top stands with her hand pressed to her mouth while a young man in a blue shirt walks toward her along the railing.
Framed through a stone archway, two figures seen from behind stand at a harbour railing overlooking the water toward the Sydney Opera House, one of them briefly extending an arm out along the rail.
A wall-mounted TV plays a flash-news report on tighter STIC monitoring measures while a young man sits alone in an empty wood-panelled diner, peeled banana in hand, looking up at the screen.

A young woman and a young man stand facing each other in a moving train car, sharing earphones plugged into the phone he holds and listening with tense, downcast faces, before the shot cuts to a passing exterior of a grey building with a NO SMOKING sign.

In a bright exam-centre lobby a suited man's polished shoes step forward past display screens, an overhead view shows a crowd of young test-takers standing in a loose group facing him, and a low angle reveals his face as he addresses them beneath a crest on the wooden wall.

Overhead top-down view of an empty toilet cubicle with a wooden door and small bin, into which a person in a dark jacket steps and crouches beside the bowl, handling something held low out of the camera's view.
From inside a dark box-like opening, the lid lifts and a young woman's face appears framed in the bright rectangular gap, looking down intently as her hands hold the edge.
Close-ups of hands handling a small object wrapped in plastic and bound with dark tape, transferring it onto a white tray held beside a wooden wall and a metal bin, with no faces in frame.
Close-up of a young woman looking down with her mouth parted in a pale indoor room, then a young man's face glimpsed through a narrow rectangular gap before the image falls to near-total darkness.
A digital wall clock reads 8:29:58 above a doorway, then in a library lined with bookshelves Lynn sits at a tablet-arm chair among other test-takers, opening her exam booklet and glancing up.
A wide wood-panelled exam hall of seated candidates, then a close-up of a wristwatch-wearing hand shading bubbles on an answer sheet, then the hall's digital clock reading 8:51:00.

A digital wall clock reads 8:51:00 above a doorway, a schoolgirl in an argyle sweater bends over her paper at a desk in a wood-panelled exam hall, and a close-up shows a pencil-filled multiple-choice answer sheet with bubbles A marked for questions 25 and 26.
A young man in a black half-zip sweater sits at a desk in a busy library, head lowered, writing on a sheet of paper while other students read around him.

Low-angle close-up of a young woman in a beige ribbed sweater crying behind a raised stack of papers under a library's wooden skylight ceiling, cutting to her tearful profile with an out-of-focus young man at the shelves behind her.

After a night exterior of a Thai printing-house signboard over shuttered gates, two students study a whiteboard timetable breaking an exam into Sections 1-4 with phones and photos taped beside it, then the young man speaks quietly into a mobile phone next to the girl in a white school shirt.

In a warehouse marked "KEEP CLEAN IN ORDER," a man in a blue polo stands in front of a long row of uniformed students facing a facing line of helmeted motorbike riders in orange vests seated on their bikes.

Inside a wooden-panelled toilet cubicle a person hides a phone under a flat white board on their lap while a young woman in an argyle sweater stares down at her phone, typing a string of answer letters (BACDCD AABCDA DBDCAB B) into a chat that already reads "thang ni phrom".
A young man sits alone in a narrow wood-panelled toilet cubicle, frowning as he thumbs a string of letter codes into a phone chat thread that already shows blocks of A/B/C/D answers.
A young man in a dark zip-up jacket squints at his phone screen, then the camera pushes into an extreme close-up of his sweat-beaded eyes as they close and reopen.
In a dark room a schoolgirl and a young man in a brown shirt lean over his phone, with an insert of the Thai chat thread where Bank demands one million more.

A woman in a blue work shirt sits behind a desk in a cluttered office looking down, then a close insert of a hand holding a phone showing a Thai chat thread demanding a money transfer within five minutes, and a young man in a dark green shirt standing under a ceiling light reading the message on his phone.
Insert of a hand holding a phone showing a Thai group chat demanding a one-million transfer within five minutes, then a close-up of a young man in a dark jacket frowning as he reads the screen.
Macro insert series on a desk: a shallow-focus dark object, a scatter of sharpened pencils laid on a pale surface, and a thumb pressing a barcode strip peeled from an eraser.
Extreme macro slide across a printed exam booklet page, moving from the blurred header reading "...age Test" and "...MINUTES" to the white-on-black question numbers 3 and then 22.

A close-up of a test booklet page reading "SECTION 3 / Math Test - Grid-In / 16 QUESTIONS, 20 MINUTES" cuts to a young woman with her hair in a bun seated in a wood-panelled exam hall beneath a red digital countdown clock, then to her profile as she bends over the paper and writes.

Tight profile close-ups of a sweating young man and a sweating young woman bent over their papers in a bright exam room, cut with an extreme close-up of the answer "0.7" written into the boxes for question 15 on an answer sheet.
In a white-tiled restroom, a young woman in an olive argyle sweater stares off with a tense, downcast expression, then stands behind two blonde girls near the stalls.
A young man sits looking down inside a wood-panelled toilet stall, then in close-up his hands type long strings of answer letters such as BDABC DB into a phone messaging thread.

A young man in a dark zip-up jacket sits holding a phone in a cramped toilet cubicle and looks up wide-eyed, then two men in dark suits are seen outside moving along the tiled washroom wall, one of them pushing at a stall door and glancing upward.
